page.about.title: About {siteName}
page.about.body1: {siteName} is a warm, passionate destination for anyone who loves the piano — beginners just starting out, active learners refining their technique, and lifelong enthusiasts who adore the instrument's history and culture. We cover all musical genres equally: classical, jazz, pop, and contemporary.
page.about.body2: Our content spans five pillars in balance: the instrument's rich history and cultural stories, practical learning and technique tips, coverage of modern developments, sheet music and practice resources, and gear reviews covering acoustic, digital, and hybrid pianos. We believe the piano belongs to everyone, and our writing reflects that — heartfelt and inviting rather than academic or gatekeeping.
page.about.body3: Whether you've just discovered a love for piano or you've been playing for decades, you'll find something here worth reading. We're building a global home for piano lovers, and we're glad you're here.
page.about.seoDescription: PianoEd is a warm, passionate destination for anyone who loves the piano — beginners, learners, and enthusiasts across all genres.

page.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
page.faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for?
page.faq.q1.question: What is this site about?
page.faq.q1.answer: This site provides articles, tools, and resources to help you explore, learn, and enjoy the piano — whether you're a beginner, active learner, or lifelong enthusiast.
page.faq.q2.question: Do I need to create an account?
page.faq.q2.answer: No. All articles, tools, and resources are free to access without registration. You may optionally subscribe to our newsletter for updates.
page.faq.q3.question: How often is new content published?
page.faq.q3.answer: We publish new articles and resources regularly. Subscribe to our newsletter or RSS feed to get notified when new content goes live.
page.faq.q4.question: Can I contribute an article?
page.faq.q4.answer: Yes! We welcome guest contributions. Please reach out via our contact page with your topic idea and a brief outline.
page.faq.q5.question: Are the tools free to use?
page.faq.q5.answer: Yes, all interactive tools on this site are completely free. No signup, no paywall, no data collection.
page.faq.q6.question: Does this site work on mobile?
page.faq.q6.answer: Absolutely. The entire site is responsive and optimized for mobile devices, including all tools and interactive features.
page.faq.seoDescription: Find answers to common questions about our site, content, tools, and how to get the most out of your visit.
